entries.confidence: deterministic for the finite quotient
entries.lower_method: Karp max-plus cycle mean on the finite weighted residue graph
entries.name: naive_residue_constrained_projective_jsr
entries.notes: The matching bound is dominated by the Mersenne all-a=1 loop, classified as negative_integer_cycle with word=[1]. This falsifies the naive residue-constrained quotient as a descent certificate.
entries.quantity: exact affine-size JSR of the largest naive legal-residue quotient
entries.upper_method: same max-plus cycle-mean certificate; scalar quotient has matching bounds

entries.confidence: deterministic for the finite filtered quotient
entries.lower_method: Karp max-plus cycle mean on the finite tail-filtered graph
entries.name: tail_filtered_cutoff_2_projective_jsr
entries.notes: Removing the Mersenne-tail states recovers the exact iid affine drift factor 3/4 at the tested quotient. This is a diagnostic, not a proof, because the positive integer dynamics must still handle those tail states.
entries.quantity: exact affine-size JSR after removing states with v2(r+1)>=2

entries.confidence: deterministic for the bounded tracked subgraph
entries.lower_method: Karp max-plus cycle mean on the finite tail-aware tracked graph
entries.name: tail_aware_projective_jsr_tracked_subgraph
entries.notes: The all-a=1 self-loop is gone, so the negative n=-1 loop no longer dominates. Positive cycle means remain at the largest saved level, and deeper-tail transitions are counted as overflow exits (44); this is not yet a closed global upper bound.
entries.quantity: exact affine-size max-cycle factor on the largest bounded (R,u mod 2^q) tracked subgraph

entries.confidence: deterministic for the bounded valuation-capped closed graph
entries.lower_method: Karp max-plus cycle mean after exact forced-run overflow compression
entries.name: tail_aware_lte_closed_projective_jsr
entries.notes: Deeper-tail overflows are compressed back to Rmax by the forced valuation-one tail identity. The resulting finite closed graph still has factor 1.2305 at the largest saved level, so worst-case constrained products remain growth-positive even after removing the n=-1 loop.
entries.quantity: exact affine-size max-cycle factor on the LTE-closed bounded (R,u mod 2^q) graph

entries.quantity: stationary average log2 growth per accelerated step on the largest LTE-closed recurrent component

entries.confidence: deterministic for scanned simple cycles up to the saved edge-depth cap

entries.upper_method: same bounded enumeration; not an all-cycle Karp certificate
